spike: 04 §2.2 — the 10 ms aggregate enrichment cap, measured

cold.note: import spacy + spacy.load + deferred first inference; paid by warm() at boot

verdict.ceiling_basis: budget + the k=1 total P99 as a stand-in for one window's cost. A k=1 total also carries fixed per-call overhead (executor dispatch, signal rebuild), so this ceiling is mildly GENEROUS — stated because a gate that flatters itself silently is worse than a looser gate that says so.
verdict.detail: worst total P99 15.767 ms against a ceiling of budget 10.0 + one k=1 call P99 5.290 = 15.290 ms (ceiling mildly generous — see ceiling_basis)

superseded.why: Measured on a genuinely quiet host (load1 0.69) and the per-window/cold figures stand. TWO things about it must not be cited. (1) Every `p99` here IS the `max`: at n=40 an interpolated P99 sits at rank 38.61 of 0..39 with no sample above it, which is why the p99 and max columns are identical in all five curve rows. (2) The `UNBOUNDED` verdict tested `budget + one k=1 call P99` — a pass line invented by this harness, not an NFR — and missed it by 0.48 ms. 04 §2.2 promises stop/log/count on exceed, never a total inside 10 ms, and cannot: the budget is checked AFTER each window, so a call overshoots by up to one window by design.
